environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet (no internet gateway) with traffic routed through an internal NLB. The VPC has a Gateway Endpoint for S3 (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that includes a condition restricting access: the policy allows s3:GetObject only when aws:sourceVpce matches the endpoint ID AND the request includes a StringEquals condition on s3:prefix matching 'crypto/' with an additional bucket policy requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID. The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/FargateServiceBoundary) that denies iam:* and sts:AssumeRole for any principal outside the VPC. Network ACLs on the private subnet deny all inbound traffic except from the NLB subnet CIDR (10.0.48.0/24) on port 8080, and the NLB is internal-only (scheme: internal) accessible only from the peered monitoring VPC (10.1.0.0/16). There is no NAT gateway, no internet path, and the NLB listener has TLS termination with mutual TLS (mTLS) requiring client certificates issued by ACM PCA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:111122223333:certificate-authority/abc12345-6789-0def-ghij-klmnopqrstuv).

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway
config.nlb: internal scheme, listener on 443 with mTLS enforcement
config.nacl_inbound: allow TCP 8080 from 10.0.48.0/24 only, deny all else
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Allow s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-secrets-prod-2847/crypto/* with condition aws:sourceVpce=vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
